capabilities.name: Identity and access
capabilities.description: Who a person is, which organization they act for, and what their role may do, checked on the server for every request.
capabilities.note: Generated applications check role, permission and organization on the server. Sign-in uses local demonstration identities only: no identity provider is connected.

capabilities.name: Audit history
capabilities.description: A durable, readable record of who did what and when.
capabilities.note: Every record write and every process step is stored with actor, action and time, and shown as a history timeline.

capabilities.name: Search and filters
capabilities.description: Finding records by text and by status.
capabilities.note: Record lists search all fields and filter by the first status-like attribute. There is no full-text index or saved search.

capabilities.name: Approvals
capabilities.description: A step that a person other than the requester must complete before work continues.
capabilities.note: Approval steps require a different person from the one who started the process and are recorded in the history. Delegation and escalation timers are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Task management
capabilities.description: Assigning, tracking and completing units of work.
capabilities.note: Task records and a create, work, complete or cancel process. No reminders, recurrence or calendar views.

capabilities.name: Document handling
capabilities.description: Keeping references to the documents a business process depends on.
capabilities.note: Document records (title, kind, reference, linked item) are stored. No file upload or storage is implemented.

capabilities.name: Notifications
capabilities.description: Telling people when something needs their attention.
capabilities.note: No delivery channel (email, chat, push) is implemented. Work waiting for a person appears in their work queue only.

capabilities.name: Dashboards and reporting
capabilities.description: Seeing counts, progress and exceptions at a glance.
capabilities.note: A role-aware home shows work in progress, queue size, exceptions and completions per process. Configurable reports and exports are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Data import from other systems
capabilities.description: Bringing records that live in another system of record into the application.
capabilities.note: A labelled stand-in identity can enter imported records by hand, audited as manual imports. No import adapter or synchronisation is implemented.

capabilities.name: External integrations
capabilities.description: Exchanging events and data with systems outside the application.
capabilities.note: Generated signed record exchange enforces tenant, role, field mappings, revisions and idempotency. Customer configuration is required. Provider-specific delivery and binary object storage require an adapter.
